Tools

Last-Hit Trainer

Allied minions (blue) slowly damage the enemy wave (red). Click or tap an enemy minion to attack it: you only get the gold if your hit is the one that kills it. Your attack has a short wind-up, and a ranged attack also needs time to fly, so attack a little before the health bar looks low enough.

Tips

  • Watch how fast each health bar drops, and start your attack just before it reaches the kill point.
  • Ranged attacks take time to fly. Start them earlier than melee attacks.
  • Don't hit a minion early unless it's about to drop too fast for you to last-hit later. That's how pros set up hard last hits.
  • Cannon minions (the big ones) are worth the most gold. Never miss them.
  • In a real game a wave has 6 minions (3 melee, 3 caster), plus a cannon minion every few waves. Around 70-80 CS at 10 minutes is a solid goal; pros get close to 100.
